questions.prompt: Have you ever learnt about outer space and stars?

answers.basic: Yes, I learned a little at school and picked up more from videos. I still find it surprising how far the light from a star has to travel. A video about the night sky made it click for me that looking at a distant star also means looking back in time.

questions.prompt: Do you like science fiction movies? Why?

answers.basic: Yes, when the story makes me think about what life would be like in a different place. I enjoy the quieter parts as much as the space battles. I like films that spend a bit of time showing how ordinary people get used to living somewhere completely unfamiliar.

questions.prompt: Do you want to know more about outer space?

answers.basic: Yes. I'd like to understand how people find planets around other stars. It's interesting that they can learn so much from a tiny change in light. I'd probably start with a short video showing what scientists see when a planet passes in front of its star.

questions.prompt: Do you want to go into outer space in the future?

answers.basic: I'd love to see the Earth from above, but I don't think I'd enjoy the launch or being far from home. Watching footage is enough for now. I can picture myself spending ages by the window, but the idea of being strapped into a rocket makes me nervous.
